idea-plugin.name: TabCue: Visual Terminal Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Style terminal tabs with custom colours, background hints, and emojis so you can tell terminals and AI agents apart at a glance.

What it does

  • Style a tab by hand — right-click any Terminal tab and pick a colour, an icon, or an emoji.
  • Or let rules do it — match on a tab's title or working directory and have the style applied automatically. Give each agent session its own emoji so a long-running agent is never mistaken for a free shell, or paint anything matching ssh prod red so you always know which machine you are on.
  • Tint the output area — optionally recolour the terminal background itself, not just the tab, for sessions you really do not want to mix up.

Notes

  • A tab's colour is also drawn as a small dot, because the IDE's tab painter replaces a custom tab colour while a tab is selected or hovered. The dot stays visible in every state.
  • Works in every IntelliJ-based IDE that bundles the Terminal — IntelliJ IDEA, PhpStorm, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, RubyMine and the rest — and with both terminal engines. Split terminals share one tab colour, since a split is several sessions in a single tab.
  • Rules are stored in .idea/terminalTabStyle.xml so they can be shared; per-tab styles live in workspace.xml because their identifiers contain local paths. Nothing is sent anywhere.
